ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, bounded by a low-intensity (black/dark grey) perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central area consists of a single contiguous high-intensity white block; low-intensity dark mapping is restricted to the peripheral trailing edge and terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations across the entire trailing edge with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes varying between 2 to 6 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves along the trailing edges, tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curved lateral tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark focal points localized specifically on the tips of individual serrations along the trailing edge boundary.
